title: The derived open-extension unit is invertible
statement: For every coefficient datum R and open immersion j, the unit of PurCompactSupport.openDerivedAdjunction R j is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 03DI, derived extension by zero on a pro-etale slice.

proof.text: Apply proEtaleOpen_slicePresentation to the specified coefficient isomorphism. The presenting equivalence is additive in both directions, so deriving the presentation gives an isomorphism from derived open extension to the derived equivalence followed by localized derived extension.

Use the proved localizedDerivedUnit_isIso helper of OpenImmersionTensorPiece. Subterminality of the open object gives the invertible localized unit, also on the unbounded derived category. Its adjunction therefore gives Full and Faithful instances for localized derived extension.

The derived presenting equivalence is fully faithful. Transfer full faithfulness of its composite with localized derived extension across the derived presentation isomorphism, and apply Adjunction.unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful to the specified openDerivedAdjunction. No quasi-compactness or nonemptiness condition is used.

proof_origin.place: Extension by zero and its exactness (Tags 03DI, 03DJ); reuse the proved localizedDerivedUnit_isIso helper and the derived slice-presentation argument from openProjectionInverse_isIso.

lean.statement:
theorem openDerivedAdjunction_unit_isIso
    (R : Coefficients.{u}) {U V : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    IsIso (openDerivedAdjunction R j).unit
